normalization: tabs / NBSP / zero-width spaces -> single space
visual lines -> paragraphs using indent + vertical gap
chapter headings removed (kept as chapter_title metadata)
drop-cap first letter re-attached to the first word
line-final hyphen joined without space (edition does not hyphenate words)
curly quotes and dashes kept as in source
known_limitations: When a chapter opens with dialogue, the drop-cap glyph carries no opening quote, so the first paragraph loses its opening quotation mark (e.g. p123 'There, look.”').
Hyphen rule assumes no word-splitting hyphenation; a real split word would keep a hyphen.

Run 1 used the most common x as the left margin; on dialogue-heavy pages that merged separate dialogue paragraphs. Found during the coherence audit (P06, p526); fixed in ingestion v3 (margin = smallest x, gap threshold from lower quartile). Run 1 results are kept in results/history/run1_paragraph_bug/.

Pages 106, 111, 352, 866 (short end-of-chapter pages where EVERY line is indented: one-line dialogue or the Sorting Hat song) have no line at the 72pt margin, so their paragraphs are merged into one. None is a gold page. Fix for a next run: fall back to the corpus-wide margin (72pt) when a page's smallest x is larger.
Paragraph detection relies on this PDF's layout (indent 14.4pt); other PDFs need re-checking.
